description: Patients who never have an examination with ANA pattern S.

b.request: Among patients in the Patient table, list the ID, sex, and average aCL IgM over all their Examination rows (ignoring NULLs, unrounded) for only those patients who have no Examination row with `ANA Pattern` = 'S', grouped by ID and sex, sorted by average descending with NULL averages last, top 10.
b.sql: SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) AS avg_acl_igm FROM Patient p LEFT JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Examination s WHERE s.ID = p.ID AND s.`ANA Pattern` = 'S') GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX ORDER BY AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) IS NULL, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) DESC LIMIT 10;
b.raw: Among patients in the Patient table, list the ID, sex, and average aCL IgM over all their Examination rows (ignoring NULLs, unrounded) for only those patients who have no Examination row with `ANA Pattern` = 'S', grouped by ID and sex, sorted by average descending with NULL averages last, top 10.

a.request: For patients none of whose examination records has an `ANA Pattern` of 'S', list each patient's ID, their sex (from the Patient table, only patients present there), and the average `aCL IgM` across all of their examinations (ignoring missing values, unrounded). Group by patient ID and sex, sort by that average from highest to lowest with missing averages last, and show the top 10.
a.sql: SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) AS avg_acl_igm FROM Patient p LEFT JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Examination x WHERE x.ID = p.ID AND x.`ANA Pattern` = 'S') GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX ORDER BY avg_acl_igm IS NULL, avg_acl_igm DESC LIMIT 10;

d.request: Among patients in the Patient table, list each patient's ID and sex and their average aCL IgM across all examinations (missing values ignored, unrounded), restricted to patients who have no examination with ANA Pattern = 'S' (including patients with no examinations at all), grouped by ID and sex, sorted by that average descending with NULLs last, top 10.
d.sql: SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) AS avg_acl_igm FROM Patient p LEFT JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Examination e2 WHERE e2.ID = p.ID AND e2.`ANA Pattern` = 'S') GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX ORDER BY avg_acl_igm DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

c.request: Among patients whose examinations don't show an `ANA Pattern` of 'S', list each patient's ID, their sex (from the Patient table, only patients present there), and the average `aCL IgM` across all of their examinations (ignoring missing values, unrounded). Group by patient ID and sex, sort by that average from highest to lowest with missing averages last, and show the top 10. Patients who never have an examination with ANA pattern S.
c.sql: SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) AS avg_acl_igm FROM Patient AS p LEFT JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Examination AS s WHERE s.ID = p.ID AND s.`ANA Pattern` = 'S') GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX ORDER BY avg_acl_igm IS NULL, avg_acl_igm DESC LIMIT 10;
